---
title: "Dissertation Book Project"
---

While details are sparse at the moment (intentionally!), I am also in the process of writing my dissertation, entitled *Standing Proud? On Responses to White Ethnonationalist Claimmaking*. Engaging work across organizational political culture, contentious politics, political sociology, history, and plenty about white nationalism's history and present, I argue that the white nationalist movements can best be understood by the processes of community-building they engage in. Specifically, I argue, or rather will argue, that the creation of discursive community is a first step in the creation of physical community and that it is the creation of *physical* community that raises the ire of the state.
